
# Housekeeping
```{r}
# Libraries and reading in our mapping system
library(sf)
library(dplyr)
library(tidycensus)
source(here::here("app", "ingest.R"))

# Create a dictionary to join with the ACS data, keeping only high priority variables
dict <- vars |>
  filter(priority == TRUE) |>
  rename(variable = "name") |>
  select(variable, table, label)
```

# Getting ACS 5-year data
```{r}
# Initialize data frame
acs5_list <- list()
# Call each of the high priority tables (24 in total right now) for each CT town
for (i in unique(dict$table)) {
  ct <- get_acs(
  geography = "county subdivision",
  state = "CT",
  table = i,
  summary_var = paste0(i, "_001"), # this adds the denominator for the percents
  year = 2024,
  output = "tidy",
  geometry = FALSE,
  survey = "acs5")

acs5_list[[i]] <- ct
}

acs5_raw <- bind_rows(acs5_list)

ct_geo <- tigris::county_subdivisions(state = "CT", year = 2024, cb = TRUE) |> 
  dplyr::select(GEOID, NAME, geometry)

# Housekeeping
clean_acs5 <- acs5_raw |>
  select(-NAME) |>
  left_join(dict, by = "variable") |>
  mutate(pct = (estimate / summary_est) * 100) |>
  left_join(ct_geo, by = "GEOID") |>
  mutate(town = sub(" town.*", "", NAME)) |>
  select(-NAME) |>
  sf::st_as_sf()

# Save cleaned data
saveRDS(clean_acs5, "app/data/acs5.rds")

```

# Getting ACS 1-year data.
Careful when running this -- sometimes the census servers are busy and variables will get skipped. If this is happening too much wait and try at a better time. 
```{r}
# Initialize data frame
acs1_list <- list()
years <- setdiff(2005:2024, 2020) # There is no ACS for 2020

for (x in years) {
    for (i in unique(dict$table)) {
      list_key <- paste0(x, "_", i)
        df <- tryCatch(
        get_acs(
            geography = "state", 
            table = i,
            state = "CT", 
            summary_var = paste0(i, "_001"),
            survey = "acs1", # need to specify since the default is acs5
            geometry = FALSE, 
            year = x), # get_acs can only take 1 year at a time
        error = function(e) {
                    message("Skipping ", x, ": ", conditionMessage(e))
                    NULL
                }) 
        if (is.null(df)) next
        df <- df |> mutate(year = x)
        acs1_list[[list_key]] <- df
    }
}

acs1_raw <- bind_rows(acs1_list)
     
clean_acs1 <- acs1_raw |>
    select(-NAME) |>
    left_join(dict, by = "variable") |>
    mutate(pct = (estimate / summary_est)*100) |>
    mutate(tooltip = paste0(year, ": ", round(pct,2), "%"))

saveRDS(clean_acs1, "app/data/acs1.rds")

```
